scenes.purpose: The truck is lost while transporting sand
scenes.camera: Three-quarter view with full truck and cargo bed visible
scenes.action: The blue toy truck has just taken a wrong fork in the orange toy construction yard and looks puzzled
scenes.props: A fork in the orange dirt track, a small mound of yellow sand in the TRUCK BED
must_see: yellow sand visibly inside blue cargo bed
scenes.narration: Eyvah! Tonton, oyuncak şantiyede kum taşırken yolunu kaybetti.

scenes.purpose: The red bridge is hidden from sight
scenes.camera: Three-quarter front view with cargo bed clearly visible, not cropped
scenes.action: The truck looks back from a bend, but tall colorful toy brick stacks block its view of the old road
scenes.props: Tall colorful toy brick stacks fully blocking the background, yellow sand still in the truck bed
must_see: yellow sand visibly inside blue cargo bed
scenes.narration: Az önce gördüğü kırmızı köprü, bir anda gözden kaybolmuştu.

scenes.purpose: The truck chooses among three roads
scenes.camera: Slightly elevated wide-angle view showing all three paths and full truck, no cropping
scenes.action: The truck stops at a very obvious three-way split, looking from left to right, unsure which path to choose
scenes.props: Exactly THREE separate sandy toy paths diverging from one junction, loaded yellow sand in truck bed
must_see: yellow sand visibly inside blue cargo bed
scenes.narration: Üç farklı yol vardı; hangisi doğruydu, hiç bilmiyordu.

scenes.camera: Medium-wide view with truck, load and all landmarks in frame
scenes.action: The truck stops to study safe toy-road markers calmly
scenes.props: Yellow arrow painted on orange toy ground, little blue tower, red flag, loaded yellow sand in the blue bed
scenes.narration: Paniklemek yerine durdu, etrafındaki renkli işaretlere dikkatle baktı.

scenes.purpose: Finds yellow arrow toward blue tower
scenes.camera: Low three-quarter view with arrow in foreground and blue tower in distance; full truck and bed visible
scenes.action: The truck discovers a yellow arrow on the ground pointing toward the blue tower
scenes.props: Clearly visible yellow ground arrow pointing to blue toy tower, a stable mound of yellow sand in truck bed
scenes.narration: Yerde bir sarı ok gördü; ok, mavi kuleyi gösteriyordu.

scenes.camera: Wide side view that shows the truck FULLY STOPPED before the pit
scenes.action: The truck stops safely at the edge of a shallow toy construction pit before it reaches the obstacle
scenes.props: One clear shallow toy pit in front, safe solid ground under all four wheels, yellow sand still in bed
scenes.narration: Küçük kamyon oku izledi, fakat önüne kocaman bir çukur çıktı.

scenes.purpose: Takes the safe path around a pit
scenes.camera: High three-quarter wide view with full side path visible
scenes.action: The truck follows a solid side path clearly going around the shallow pit
scenes.props: A safe bypass path with visible pit to the side, yellow sand still in cargo bed
scenes.narration: Çukurun yanındaki güvenli patikayı seçip yavaşça ilerledi.

scenes.purpose: Finds the red bridge and unloading area
scenes.camera: Wide scene with full truck and unmistakable red toy bridge in same frame
scenes.action: The truck recognizes the RED TOY BRIDGE ahead, with the toy sand-unloading box behind the bridge
scenes.props: Clearly visible red toy bridge in the foreground/distance, unloading box behind it, yellow sand still in bed
scenes.narration: Sonunda kırmızı köprü göründü! Aradığı kum boşaltma alanı hemen arkasındaydı.

scenes.camera: Clear side view of same truck with dump bed visibly tilted and sand pouring
scenes.action: The same blue truck tips its own cargo bed, letting yellow sand pour safely into the designated unloading box
scenes.props: The toy unloading box beside red bridge, yellow sand visibly falling from the tilted blue cargo bed
must_see: yellow sand pouring into unloading box
must_not_see: sand still piled in lowered bed
scenes.narration: Tonton kumunu bıraktı ve dönüş yolundaki işaretleri tek tek izledi.

scenes.purpose: Returns with an empty truck bed and lesson learned
scenes.camera: Medium-wide three-quarter shot showing empty cargo bed and recognizable landmarks
scenes.action: The truck heads home confidently following markers, with its cargo bed visibly EMPTY after unloading
scenes.props: Yellow floor arrow, little blue tower, red toy bridge far behind, visibly empty blue truck bed
scenes.narration: Artık biliyordu: Yolunu şaşırınca sakin kalıp işaretlere dikkat etmek önemliydi.
